description: This file defines infrastructure for processing custom attributes and annotations used in pybind11, including class and function annotations, call policies, and metadata structures for functions and types.

classes.name: is_method
classes.description: Annotation struct for marking functions as methods, holding a class handle.

classes.name: is_setter
classes.description: Annotation struct for marking functions as setters.

classes.name: is_operator
classes.description: Annotation struct for marking functions as operators.

classes.name: is_final
classes.description: Annotation struct indicating a class cannot be subclassed.

classes.name: scope
classes.description: Annotation struct for parent scope, holding a handle.

classes.name: doc
classes.description: Annotation struct for documentation string.

classes.name: name
classes.description: Annotation struct for function name.

classes.name: sibling
classes.description: Annotation struct for overload sibling handle.

classes.name: base
classes.description: Template struct indicating inheritance from a type, deprecated in favor of class_ template parameter.

classes.name: keep_alive
classes.description: Template struct for call policy to keep objects alive during function calls.

classes.name: multiple_inheritance
classes.description: Annotation struct for multiple inheritance indicator.

classes.name: dynamic_attr
classes.description: Annotation struct to enable dynamic attributes (__dict__).

classes.name: buffer_protocol
classes.description: Annotation struct to enable buffer protocol.

classes.name: release_gil_before_calling_cpp_dtor
classes.description: Annotation struct to release GIL before C++ destructor call.

classes.name: metaclass
classes.description: Annotation struct for specifying a custom metaclass handle.

classes.name: custom_type_setup
classes.description: Struct for custom type setup callback, used to customize Python type creation.

classes.name: module_local
classes.description: Annotation struct marking a class as local to the module.

classes.name: arithmetic
classes.description: Annotation struct marking enums as arithmetic types.

classes.name: prepend
classes.description: Annotation struct to prepend function overloads.

classes.name: call_guard
classes.description: Template struct for call policies with guard variables.

classes.name: argument_record
classes.description: Metadata struct for keyword arguments.

classes.name: function_record
classes.description: Metadata struct for bound functions, including signature, overloads, and attributes.

classes.name: type_record
classes.description: Metadata struct for bound classes/types, including inheritance, attributes, and lifecycle info.

classes.name: is_keep_alive
classes.description: Type trait to identify keep_alive call policies.

classes.name: is_call_guard
classes.description: Type trait to identify call_guard instantiations.

classes.name: extract_guard_t
classes.description: Template alias to extract the first call_guard type from variadic arguments.

classes.name: expected_num_args
classes.description: Compile-time check for expected number of function arguments based on annotations.
